attachments_dimensions_positive.name: attachments_dimensions_positive
attachments_dimensions_positive.value: ("attachments"."width" IS NULL OR "attachments"."width" > 0) AND ("attachments"."height" IS NULL OR "attachments"."height" > 0)

comments_anchor_doc_only.name: comments_anchor_doc_only
comments_anchor_doc_only.value: ("comments"."anchor_id" IS NULL AND "comments"."anchor_text" IS NULL) OR "comments"."entity_type" = 'doc'

comments_anchor_text_needs_anchor.name: comments_anchor_text_needs_anchor
comments_anchor_text_needs_anchor.value: "comments"."anchor_text" IS NULL OR ("comments"."anchor_id" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("comments"."anchor_text") <= 500)

comments_resolved_by_needs_resolved_at.name: comments_resolved_by_needs_resolved_at
comments_resolved_by_needs_resolved_at.value: "comments"."resolved_by" IS NULL OR "comments"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL

comments_reply_plain.name: comments_reply_plain
comments_reply_plain.value: "comments"."parent_id" IS NULL OR ("comments"."anchor_id" IS NULL AND "comments"."anchor_text" IS NULL AND "comments"."resolved_at" IS NULL)

docs_project_handbook_file_unique.name: docs_project_handbook_file_unique
docs_project_handbook_file_unique.where: "docs"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND coalesce("docs"."handbook_path", "docs"."source_path") IS NOT NULL

docs_handbook_path_format.name: docs_handbook_path_format
docs_handbook_path_format.value:
"docs"."handbook_path" IS NULL OR ("docs"."handbook_path" ~ '^([A-Za-z0-9_-][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*/)*[A-Za-z0-9_-][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*[.]md$'
    AND char_length("docs"."handbook_path") <= 200
    AND strpos("docs"."handbook_path", '..') = 0)

docs_handbook_synced_together.name: docs_handbook_synced_together
docs_handbook_synced_together.value:
("docs"."handbook_blob_sha" IS NULL) = ("docs"."handbook_synced_version" IS NULL)
        AND ("docs"."handbook_blob_sha" IS NULL) = ("docs"."handbook_synced_at" IS NULL)

docs_handbook_remote_sha_seen.name: docs_handbook_remote_sha_seen
docs_handbook_remote_sha_seen.value: "docs"."handbook_remote_sha" IS NULL OR "docs"."handbook_remote_seen_at" IS NOT NULL

github_refs_kind_columns.name: github_refs_kind_columns
github_refs_kind_columns.value:
("github_refs"."kind" = 'pr' AND "github_refs"."number" IS NOT NULL AND "github_refs"."state" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("github_refs"."kind" = 'commit' AND "github_refs"."sha" IS NOT NULL AND "github_refs"."state" IS NULL)
        OR ("github_refs"."kind" = 'branch' AND "github_refs"."ref_name" IS NOT NULL AND "github_refs"."state" IS NULL)

handbook_publications_merged_has_pr.name: handbook_publications_merged_has_pr
handbook_publications_merged_has_pr.value: "handbook_publications"."state" NOT IN ('merged', 'closed') OR "handbook_publications"."pr_number" IS NOT NULL

incidents_times_ordered.name: incidents_times_ordered
incidents_times_ordered.value:
("incidents"."mitigated_at" IS NULL OR "incidents"."mitigated_at" >= "incidents"."started_at")
        AND ("incidents"."resolved_at" IS NULL
          OR "incidents"."resolved_at" >= coalesce("incidents"."mitigated_at", "incidents"."started_at"))

services_json_arrays.name: services_json_arrays
services_json_arrays.value:
jsonb_typeof("services"."environments") = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof("services"."links") = 'array'
        AND jsonb_array_length("services"."environments") <= 50
        AND jsonb_array_length("services"."links") <= 50
